tasks.label: test-affiliate-links-e2e
args: cd /d "${workspaceFolder}" && set PLAYWRIGHT_SKIP_WEB_SERVER=1&& set BASE_URL=http://localhost:3001&& npx playwright test tests/e2e/affiliate-links.spec.js --reporter=line --workers=1

tasks.label: write-mp4-headers
args: cd /d c:\Users\admin\premium-invest-8 && pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$u='https://fuselabcreative.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/managing-stadium-events.mp4'; try { $r=Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $u -Method Head -MaximumRedirection 5 -TimeoutSec 30; $lines=@(); $lines += ('StatusCode: ' + $r.StatusCode); $lines += ('FinalUri: ' + $r.BaseResponse.ResponseUri); foreach ($h in $r.Headers.Keys) { $lines += ($h + ': ' + $r.Headers[$h]) }; $lines | Set-Content -Encoding UTF8 .tmp_mp4_headers.txt } catch { ('ERROR: ' + $_.Exception.Message) | Set-Content -Encoding UTF8 .tmp_mp4_headers.txt }"

tasks.label: download-ffmpeg-portable
args: cd /d c:\Users\admin\premium-invest-8 && if not exist .tools mkdir .tools && if not exist .tools\ffmpeg mkdir .tools\ffmpeg && curl -L --max-time 120 -o .tools\ffmpeg\ffmpeg-release-essentials.zip https://www.gyan.dev/ffmpeg/builds/ffmpeg-release-essentials.zip

tasks.label: extract-ffmpeg-portable
args: $zip='.tools/ffmpeg/ffmpeg-release-essentials.zip'; $dest='.tools/ffmpeg'; if (Test-Path $dest) { } ; Expand-Archive -Force -Path $zip -DestinationPath $dest; Get-ChildItem -Path $dest -Directory | Select-Object -First 5 | Format-Table Name

tasks.label: extract-sampled-frames
args: cd /d c:\Users\admin\premium-invest-8 && if not exist .tmp_frames mkdir .tmp_frames && .tools\ffmpeg\bin\ffmpeg.exe -hide_banner -loglevel error -i .tmp_managing-stadium-events.mp4 -vf "fps=1/2,scale=320:-1" -frames:v 12 .tmp_frames\frame_%02d.png

tasks.label: qa-curl-sip-vs-panic
args: $base='http://localhost:3000'; Write-Host '--- redirect sip-vs-panic-selling'; curl.exe -sI "$base/intelligence/sip-vs-panic-selling" | Select-String -Pattern '^HTTP/|^location:'; Write-Host '--- redirect sip-vs-panic-simulator'; curl.exe -sI "$base/intelligence/sip-vs-panic-simulator" | Select-String -Pattern '^HTTP/|^location:'; Write-Host '--- redirect stop-sip-during-crash'; curl.exe -sI "$base/intelligence/stop-sip-during-crash" | Select-String -Pattern '^HTTP/|^location:'; Write-Host '--- canonical status'; curl.exe -sI "$base/intelligence/sip-vs-panic" | Select-Object -First 1; Write-Host '--- json-ld present?'; $html = curl.exe -s "$base/intelligence/sip-vs-panic"; Write-Host ("jsonLd=" + ($html | Select-String -Pattern 'application/ld\+json' -Quiet)); Write-Host '--- api/events status'; $resp = curl.exe -s -D - -o NUL -X POST "$base/api/events" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"event_type":"calculator_view","data":{"calculator_type":"sip_vs_panic_selling"}}'; $resp | Select-String -Pattern '^HTTP/' -AllMatches | Select-Object -First 1

tasks.label: qa-curl-sip-vs-panic-2
args: & { $base='http://localhost:3000'; Write-Host '--- redirect sip-vs-panic-selling'; curl.exe -sI "$base/intelligence/sip-vs-panic-selling" | Select-String -Pattern '^(HTTP/|location:)'; Write-Host '--- redirect sip-vs-panic-simulator'; curl.exe -sI "$base/intelligence/sip-vs-panic-simulator" | Select-String -Pattern '^(HTTP/|location:)'; Write-Host '--- redirect stop-sip-during-crash'; curl.exe -sI "$base/intelligence/stop-sip-during-crash" | Select-String -Pattern '^(HTTP/|location:)'; Write-Host '--- canonical status'; curl.exe -sI "$base/intelligence/sip-vs-panic" | Select-String -Pattern '^HTTP/' | Select-Object -First 1; Write-Host '--- json-ld present?'; $html = curl.exe -s "$base/intelligence/sip-vs-panic"; Write-Host ("jsonLd=" + ($html | Select-String -Pattern 'application/ld\+json' -Quiet)); Write-Host '--- api/events status'; $hdr = curl.exe -s -D - -o NUL -X POST "$base/api/events" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"event_type":"calculator_view","data":{"calculator_type":"sip_vs_panic_selling"}}'; $hdr | Select-String -Pattern '^HTTP/' | Select-Object -First 1 }
